Create ONE NEW landscape1536x1024 TRANSPARENT PNG KFB ink monster character sheet. EXACTLY SIX UNIQUE MEN-IN-BLACK / CIA-SPOOK-STYLE AGENTS in THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS. Original fictional secret-bureau archetypes, shared group outfit but six strongly different personalities. No real actor likeness, movie-character replicas, real agency logos, insignia, lettering or branding.
Both input PNGs STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: first for whole rounded charcoal-violet ink body, rich soft plasticine and sculpted lids; second for beautiful modeled clay props. New original actors, not edits or copied faces/outfits.
EVERY actor ONE continuous COMPLETE UPRIGHT FOOTLESS charcoal-black ink splat, subtle dark-purple sheen, thick soft asymmetric rounded lobes, giant face directly in goo, tiny rounded goo hands, a few contained droplets. NO human torso/legs/feet, severed bust, angular stone or fur body. Tactile hand-sculpted plasticine with smooth rounded volumes, fine fingerprints, selective seams/wear; weird offbeat cartoon, not polished Pixar humans.
SHARED UNIFORM: small tailored BLACK LAPELS at upper body sides, two crisp IVORY SHIRT-COLLAR TRIANGLES and ONE NARROW BLACK TIE down own belly, subtle seam details, optional tiny silver earpiece. Only partial suit accents, most ink body visible. Jacket/lapels cool jet-black distinguishable from violet-black goo; do not dress a human-shaped body in a full suit. No pants, shoes, trenchcoat covering body or bare human skin.
ALL EYES WHITE/IVORY sclera around distinct small RED iris and BLACK pupil, thick purple-black clay lids. SIX faces completely unobscured. NO SUNGLASSES over ANY EYE. Only ONE pair of black sunglasses, held LOW as a prop by top-middle agent; other agents have none in front of face. No eyepatches/masks. Six different eye proportions, gaze, brow/lid weights, mouth shapes and lips. Irregular ivory teeth if shown, no six identical angry grins or dangling tongues.

TOP LEFT — MALE-READ SECTION CHIEF / HANDLER. Huge broad low pear blob with one short folded crown loop, small worn BLACK FEDORA, shared black lapels/ivory collar/thin black tie. Deadpan authoritarian fatigue: one half-lidded white eye huge, opposite compressed, one brow high and other drooped, enormous CLOSED crooked lower lip with one lower tooth. Both hands hold ONE short broad BLACK LEATHER ATTACHE CASE against belly, two bold silver clasps and sturdy handle, no labels. Grip more anxious than face, no weapon.
TOP MIDDLE — FEMALE-READ FIELD AGENT. Tall hooked bean with two small crown nubs, one short dark clay quiff, subtle lashes, shared collar/tie/lapels and one tiny silver earpiece. Cool predatory confidence: white eyes look SIDEWAYS in unequal squints, one raised arched brow and one low straight brow, tiny CLOSED asymmetrical smirk with one small upper fang. One hand holds ONE pair of thick BLACK SUNGLASSES folded LOW against own belly, well below chin; other holds ONE short fat silver PENLIGHT with plain rounded lens end pointing DOWN. No beam, glowing gadget, film-specific device or sunglasses on head/eyes.
TOP RIGHT — MALE-READ LISTENING TECHNICIAN. Round top-heavy ink dumpling with three uneven fat crown drops, no hat, shared suit accents. Nervous over-attention: two huge unequal white eyes look UP in different directions, inner brows raised, small clenched mouth with one central tooth and puffed lower lip. One earpiece with a short coiled BLACK CORD visibly connects to ONE chunky compact REEL-TO-REEL RECORDER held at belly: two simple silver reels, one obvious dark tape strip, one red button, handle. Two round reels only, no impossible machinery or text. One hand touches own earpiece, other supports recorder.
BOTTOM LEFT — MALE-READ REDACTION OFFICER. Broad near-square soft splat with one drooping sideways lobe, no hat, shared collar/tie/lapels. Precise offended indignation: white eyes glare DOWN unevenly, one hard low brow and other raised in disbelief, skewed shallow rectangular mouth with three clenched unequal teeth and huge lip. Holds ONE thick cream DOSSIER FOLDER with exactly THREE bold BLACK REDACTION BARS across its cover, no actual writing. Other hand grips ONE squat rectangular BLACK RUBBER STAMP with red wooden handle low against body. No stamped words or censorship scene, just props.
BOTTOM MIDDLE — FEMALE-READ INTERVIEWER, unsettlingly pleasant. Compact wavy-edged pear blob with one short curled clay side lock, subtle lashes, shared black suit accents. Over-polite apparent warmth concealing scrutiny: huge white eyes stare directly toward viewer at slightly different openness, eyebrows curved unequally, stretched SHALLOW crooked smile with two tiny widely spaced teeth, tense cheek fold. One hand cradles ONE small plain IVORY COFFEE CUP at own belly; other shows ONE small open BLACK BADGE WALLET with plain dull silver OVAL insert, blank with no logo/text. No table, chair, restraints or another person.
BOTTOM RIGHT — MALE-READ OBSERVATION PHOTOGRAPHER. Tall bent kidney blob with coiled crown curl, little narrow-brim black felt hat tilted back, shared collar/tie/lapels. Furious embarrassed vigilance: one enormous white eye stares SIDEWAYS and other squints, asymmetric high/low brows, almost CLOSED nervous sneer with one offset tooth, enormous lower lip. Both hands hug ONE oversized old BLACK BOX CAMERA at lower belly, one huge silver-rimmed round lens, one short silver FLASH REFLECTOR at side and a thick simple shutter button. No flash firing, film reels, tripod, camera raised over eyes or extra gadget. Entire camera complete within own cell.

COMPOSITION: six LARGE complete independent figures in regular3x2 visual grid, similar substantial body height across rows. Whole silhouettes450-470px per512pxlogical cell, generous clear margins/gutters especially32-40px between rows. All hats/cases/glasses/gadgets/cups/folders/camera/droplets inside own cell, no touching/overlap across neighbors or cut-off details. No miniature bottom row. Faces and goo remain dominant, shared outfit clearly coherent. No gridlines, text, watermark, scenery, floor, shadow disc, backdrop gradient, checkerboard or halo. Real alpha-zero transparent background, opaque interiors, clean antialiased edges. Soft upper-left studio lighting on figures only.
